thread:
rhea: quick heads-up: after the new quant kernel landed on q4b-int4-c we see a weird shift on our "clarify+context" prompt slice. not classic hallucination — more like mid-answer truncation and occasional repeated prefix tokens.
maya: can you snapshot the failing slice and a couple of paired outputs? how large is the effect?
rhea: ran a small eval (n=300). completeness fp16=0.91 vs int4=0.55. repeated-prefix cases ~6% of failures. truncations cluster at ~512-768 token mark.
anj: hmm makes me think of a KV cache write/read mismatch at chunk boundaries. any padding/rollover changes in this deploy?
sam: infra-bot, any recent changes to fused-attn or seq-pad on int4 workers?
infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-20: adjusted pad-left alignment for quant fused-attn to reduce CUDA kernel divergence. flagged low-risk. TRACE: infra/7264 attached.
maya: labeling-bot, can you assemble a 80-sample microgolden from the top regressors and route to golden-ops? need humans to confirm whether outputs are actually degraded or metric is over-sensitive.
labeling-bot: microgolden created (80/300) -> assigned to "golden-ops". ETA ~6h.
sam: while labels run i'll produce a paired-diff bundle: fp16 vs int4 outputs, token-level probs, and a quick script that marks first mismatch token and last non-empty token. sharing in ~40m.
rhea: example pair inline:
 - fp16: "...to configure the webhook, set the target URL and then click Confirm to enable. after that the webhook will start delivering events."
 - int4: "...to configure the webhook, set the target URL and then click Confirm"
anj: also seeing cases where int4 emits a repeated small token like "the the the" before stopping — could be beam/decoding edge. which sampler/settings were used?
sam: greedy decode with no sampling on this eval (match prod).
maya: evals-bot, can you run a token-level KL / entropy diff between fp16 and int4 for the slice? could reveal overconfidence collapse before stop.
evals-bot: scheduled: token-kl-run-615888 at low priority. ETA 90m.
anj: action items:
 - sam: upload paired-diff bundle + 50 representative examples (ASAP)
 - maya: audit completeness metric for truncation counting (today)
 - infra-bot: attach kernel traces and confirm pad-left revert test on a canary node (ETA EOD)
 - olivia: prepare rollback plan for routes that match the long-multi-turn signature (canary to fp16 5%)
 - labeling-bot: post interim label counts at 20/80 and 80/80

rhea: note: this prompt slice is used in internal canary for a customer-facing clarification flow — want to keep it offline until we confirm.
olivia: acknowledged, will hold the canary toggle until labels + diffs come back.
sam: uploading diffs now. will update thread when evals-bot outputs KL numbers.
labeling-bot: interim update: 20/80 complete -> 12 marked degraded by gold reviewers.
maya: ok that's already non-trivial. if final >30% then we treat as production-quality regression and rollback.

rhea: thanks all — please keep updates in this thread. tagging @anj @infra-bot for kernel follow-up.
